name: DeKalb County, IL
findings: DeKalb County has 382 nonprofit organizations. 166 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 142 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, DeKalb County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 19 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.
